algorithm_title: Find the continuous subarray with the maximum sum (Kadane's algorithm)
evidence_summary: This suite provides partial behavioural evidence using 3 predefined common behavioural tests, with covered normal-path behaviour. Array values/length are internally random; seeded runs give reproducible variation but do not guarantee every restart/tie pattern.
coverage_basis: Assessment is based on the 3 predefined common behavioural tests, the behaviours exposed by the frozen program interface, and the declared coverage dimensions: normal path.
interpretation_guidance: Interpret behavioural accuracy as useful but incomplete evidence across the declared exercised behaviours; unexercised behaviours remain outside the direct evidence.
coverage_limitations: Array values/length are internally random; seeded runs give reproducible variation but do not guarantee every restart/tie pattern.
